blocks.text: “I thought I'd got sober. I'd no business to drink to-night. But it's in my head yet—worse'n when we started hére. I'm all in a muddle; can't recollect anything of it hardly.Tell me, Joe—honest, now, old feller—did I do it? Joe,I never meant to—pon my soul and honor I never meant to,Joe. Tell me how it was Joe. O, it's awful—and him so young and promising."
